title: bsp_game.exe milestone 2f: a headless mission frame

machine_steps.note: BSP_Game_OnInitOnce builds the machine once per process; this process reaches its first mission at the load, so the machine is built there and kept
the native panic body was never read; the executable installs its own
the DoFile global the binding table does not carry
the bytes come from the 00884770 singleton in the native; this process reads Scripts/fundamentals.lua through the mounted providers and keeps the chunk label
the table is created with its thirteen fields so a script can index it; the values themselves come from session state this process does not own
the content-suffix list is empty, so every query answers with the base file
no frame job pool, so no named call is ever queued for the main thread

load_steps.note: the eight 118h records at game+1008h and the local slot 004bb440 claims
needs a bsp::GlobalSubsystemContext nothing in the repository builds; one step inside it does run, 004dc72f calling 00886900
milestone 2e stopped in front of this step
the header pass against the live database; the record-filling pass already ran in milestone 2e against the same bytes
the Registration and Instantiate passes, where the entities appear
the names split off record+980h; this scene record carries none
the container it rebuilds was never identified
Scripts/missions/usn/usn_2_java.lua, one chunk, no content variant
the first of the eleven calls between 004e0a9b and 004e0acd
not reached: the walk runs the entry points without the collection between them
luaEngineMovieInit; raw script slot 9 only, which this mission is not
vtable +E4h of the renderer at 00f8d394, an indirect call
[00f8a2fc]+48h from record+1098h; the executable owns the field
the global is nulled; the frame reads the same flag for MissionFrame::interface_manager_present
game+7188h; nothing in this process builds a new one, which is why the debrief request 0Fh is unreachable
the same routine the state 0Ch handler calls; run over the reconstructed action records with no backend

entry_steps.note: no input backend, so the executable injects one device-down sample and the recovered latch at table+DDh turns it into one rising edge. The injection is the executable's own, not recovered behaviour
not reached: the player-count arm belongs to session mode 1
the list is empty in this process, so no handle reaches 00c34f70
with 0: the arm that tears the loading element down, releases interface/textures/allbutingame.ats, selects layout set 3 and writes game+1EE0h
not reached: the call is behind the networked-session test
clearing the hide flag clears both cinematic bytes and opens the simulation gate

corrections.is: the CALL 0045f520 for luaPrecacheUnits is at 004e0a96; 004e0a9b is CALL 0095ca70, the first of the eleven precache calls the same comment block attributes to 004e0a9b..004e0acd
corrections.evidence: python tools/bsp.py ghidra xrefs 0045f520 -> 004e0a96 and 004e0c2e in BSP_Game_LoadMissionScene; python tools/bsp.py disasm-raw 004e0a90 --length 24 -> 004e0a96 call 0x45f520 / 004e0a9b call 0x95ca70

corrections.is: 005e2f00 is BSP_Game_SyncLobbySettingsFromLua: it opens the LobbySettings global and walks the thirteen slots of 00e08908. It resets no Lua state. The method name is a call-site guess of the kind rule 1 of docs/WORKER_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md forbids.
corrections.evidence: docs/MISSION_LUA_MACHINE.md, the 005e2f00 section; python tools/bsp.py ghidra xrefs 005e2f00 -> 004e02d0 in BSP_Game_LoadMissionScene

corrections.target: docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2e, "the load stops at reset_render_scene [00874640]"
corrections.was: the run stops at the first step whose owner is the renderer or the scene graph
corrections.is: the load walks every remaining step of the inventory. 00874640 is still the first renderer-owner step and is still a record; it is no longer where the run stops.
corrections.evidence: local/game_run.log: "mission load finished: 47 steps, 10 concrete, 32 records, 5 arms not taken; game state = 0x0C"

corrections.target: milestone 2e, the mission script path in the report
corrections.was: Scripts/missions/usn_2_java.lua, derived from the scene stem alone
corrections.is: Scripts/missions/usn/usn_2_java.lua. Scripts/missions/ holds no loose .lua, so the name must carry a subdirectory; the executable derives it from the scene file's parent directory and confirms it against the mounted tree.
corrections.evidence: docs/MISSION_LUA_MACHINE.md gap 2; local/game_run.log "mission script name derived from the scene path"

known_defects.effect: the stored Ghidra body of BSP_Game_OnMove is eight bytes (004e4a40-004e4a47), so tools/verify_report_calls.py reports every one of the 57 frame_steps call sites as "in no Ghidra function". The addresses come from bsp::mission_frame_step(), which read them from the disk bytes 004e4a40-004e5535.
